# [V3] Game events usable for visible parity (generated by tools/events_for_parity_V3.py, 2026-10-11)

Id = the number the event tap sees (`ui_events_V2`). Sender = function in the exe that raises it (RVA, build
870227EC; empty = raised by name from another path, the static scan found no call site). All seats = the game marks
it `networked="true"` in `Libs/EventList.xml` (sent to every seat); local = a seat has it only if its own game
raises it. Kept = the recorder writes it today. Counts: host / client2_windows / client_wsl.
